description: WRITE: queues a real-browser scan of the site's sign-up / checkout and cancellation flow (1-3 minutes). Confirm with the user before calling repeatedly; scans count against fair-use limits. In live mode the account must be activated (verified domain). Poll get_scan until completed, then get_site_status or get_compliance_plan. After code changes prefer verify_task / verify_site, which pre-check instantly and queue the scan for you.

regions.description: States to scan from, e.g. ["US-CA"] (default: the site configuration).

site.description: Site id (site_…). Optional when the account has exactly one site in this mode; list_sites shows them.

name: run_scan
title: Run a synthetic-shopper scan (write)
